name: comp-455

frames.best_why: Both ghost buttons and all four invoice rows are fully visible with the cursor away.

tagline: Bare Previous and Next links at a card footer, their arrows nudging on hover.
summary: A minimum pagination footer with a ghost Previous on the left and Next on the right; hovering slides the small arrow a touch outward and no button gains a fill.
appearance: A dark rounded card holds four thin invoice rows split by hairlines; beneath them a footer row sets a background-free Previous with a left arrow at the left edge and Next with a right arrow at the right edge.
behaviour: Hovering Previous nudges its left arrow slightly left and hovering Next nudges its right arrow slightly right, while the rows and card stay still. The buttons never take a filled background.
demo_content: Invoice rows INV-2031 to INV-2034 for Acme Corp, Globex, Initech and Umbrella with amounts and statuses.
search_phrases: next button on the right of a table
go to the next page of invoices
page back and forward at the bottom
simple footer navigation for a list
use_when: A light pagination footer under a table where numbered pages would add clutter.
avoid_when: When people need to jump far: only back and forward exist, with no page numbers.
customise: Pass currentPage and totalPages to drive the labels and disabled state; the arrow nudge, ghost styling and spacing are fixed in the classes.
weight_why: Two ghost buttons with a tiny transform; nothing loops or runs heavy work.

a11y.note: Buttons have clear text and an aria-disabled state, but the arrow nudge has no reduced-motion alternative.

issues: Neither button has an onClick handler, so the demo cannot actually change page.
polish_why: Restrained ghost pagination with a neat arrow nudge; a very familiar pattern.
title: Ghost Arrow Pagination
